newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia c.bank sells 24.5 mln kuna, rates flat.
newsitem.headline: Croatia c.bank sells 24.5 mln kuna, rates flat.

text.p: Croatia's central bank sold 24.5 million kuna in 35- and 91-day liquidity bills at an auction on Friday, instead of a regular weekly bill sale that falls on Wednesdays.
The bank accepted 20 out of 27 million kuna bids by banks for 35-day bills at a steady 8.0 percent.
The rest was sold in 91-day bills at 9.5 percent, also unchanged from a previous price.

Monday's mandatory reserve payment drained a total of 3.3 billion kuna from the banking system, very slightly less than under a fortnight ago, an official told Reuters. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
